Oxatomide is an H1 antihistamine similar to diphenhydramine.
It has been shown to have an antiviral effect against Venezuelan Equine Encephalitis virus[51] which is a New World alphavirus that is more lethal than chikungunya.
Oxatomide is an over the counter drug that can be purchased online.
It is unclear as to whether it will be effective against chikungunya virus, more work is needed to test this compound against other alphaviruses.
